guide.disclaimer: Recommendations are provided in good faith by your hosts and may change without notice. They are not guarantees — please verify opening hours and confirm bookings directly before you go.
guide.heroSubtitle: Your home away from home on the Costa del Sol — golf, sea and sun, all within easy reach.
guide.feature1Body: From championship golf courses to quiet coastal walks, we've gathered our favourite things to do nearby — with real distances and honest tips, not just links.
guide.feature2Body: Tapas bars, beach clubs, and a few local favourites — each one picked because we've been there ourselves, not because it looked good online.
guide.amenityWifiBody: Network details for the house and the social club are in the house manual.
guide.amenityCheckinBody: Clear directions, gate codes, and key handover — all in one place.
guide.amenityParkingBody: Two private spaces right outside the front door.
guide.amenityLanguageBody: Every page of this guide is available in both languages.
guide.manualCtaBody: WiFi passwords, appliance instructions, house rules, and emergency contacts — all behind your shared guest code.

manual.title: House manual
manual.gateBody: Your booking confirmation or your host includes a short access code for the house manual.
manual.wrongCode: That code isn't right. Please check your booking confirmation or message your host.
manual.softNotice: This code is a simple shared password for all guests, not a personal login — it keeps this page out of search engines but isn't strong security. Please don't share it outside your group.

admin.loginError: Couldn't sign in. Check your email and password.
admin.notAdmin: You're signed in, but this account isn't on the admin allowlist. Ask an existing admin to add you (see RULES.md).
admin.showcaseHint: Public marketing page for prospective guests at /house. Different audience from the rest of the guide — this is what convinces someone to book, not what they need once they're staying.
admin.showcaseFirstImageHint: The first image (drag to reorder) is also used as the hero background on the guide's landing page.
admin.rotateConfirm: Generate a new guest code? Anyone with the old code will lose access immediately.

house.ctaBody: Check availability on Airbnb, or get in touch with Sotogrande Exclusive directly.
